## 镜头 2：重刹弯 T1–T2（6 秒）

- 弯道：T1 左 105° 发夹弯 · T2 右侧小弯
- 海拔：9 m → 13 m，T1 处为全圈最低点 8 m
- 速度：约 320 → 85 km/h

**运行前** 先把挑好的关键帧放进 `input/`：首帧 `dream7_K1.png`，尾帧 `dream7_K2.png`。文件不存在时 LoadImage 会报 *value not in list*。

点一次 **运行** 生成 2 条候选，视频保存在 `output/video/dream7/`，文件名形如 `shot_02_t1_00001_.mp4`。

挑出最好的一条，复制为拼接脚本读取的文件：

```
mkdir -p output/video/dream7/selected
cp output/video/dream7/shot_02_t1_00001_.mp4 output/video/dream7/selected/shot_02.mp4
```

Very late, very heavy braking from top speed: the nose dips hard and the car dives down the inside, to the LEFT of the red car, and overtakes it under braking. The road turns sharply LEFT through a tight hairpin, then a quick short flick to the RIGHT, and the car accelerates away as the road begins to rise. Single continuous take from the same onboard camera, no cuts, no camera switch, the car always moves forward and never reverses, no on-screen text, no watermark. Visual style: Photorealistic onboard racing footage filmed by a T-cam mounted just above and behind the driver's helmet of a dark-blue open-wheel single-seater race car with a white nose. Only the halo safety bar, the top of the cockpit and the front wing tips are visible at the bottom of the frame; the camera height and framing never change. Sunny afternoon, clear blue sky, warm consistent sunlight. Grey asphalt circuit with white edge lines, red-and-white striped kerbs on every corner, green grass run-off, blue barrier walls, rolling green hills and scattered trees in the distance. Cinematic, sharp, natural colours, 16:9. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermark.
